item.title: A joint statement issued at the close of His Highness the Amir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani's state visit to Germany on 20 and 21 Novemb…
item.description:
A joint statement issued at the close of His Highness the Amir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani's state visit to Germany on 20 and 21 November saw both countries reaffirm their commitment to UN Security Council resolution 2817 (2026) and the need to keep trade routes open without fees or payments. The two sides condemned Iranian attacks on Qatar and regional states, rejected any move to close the Strait of Hormuz, urged the Houthis to stop targeting civilian shipping, and renewed their call for a two-state solution on the 4 June 1967 borders and for a cessation of hostilities in Ukraine.
Sources: The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/21/11/2026/joint-declaration-on-occasion-of-state-visit-of-the-amir-to-federal-republic-of-germany · Youm7 (MENA) https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/21/%D9%82%D8%B7%D8%B1-%D9%88%D8%A3%D9%84%D9%85%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A7-%D8%AA%D8%A4%D9%83%D8%AF%D8%A7%D9%86-%D8%B6%D8%B1%D9%88%D8%B1%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D8%AD%D8%AA%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%85-%D8%AD%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AD%D8%A9-%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%85%D8%AA%D9%86%D8%A7%D8%B9-%D8%B9%D9%86-%D8%A3%D9%8A/7627456

item.title: The Qatari-German joint statement welcomed the Qatar Investment Authority's announcement of EUR 15 billion in investments in Germany over f…
item.description:
The Qatari-German joint statement welcomed the Qatar Investment Authority's announcement of EUR 15 billion in investments in Germany over five years, subject to independent investment decisions, and bilateral trade exceeding USD 2 billion in 2025. It also welcomed two security cooperation agreements and a Status of Forces Agreement, a memorandum on peace, reconciliation and conflict resolution, and a joint declaration of intent on co-financing between the Qatar Fund for Development and Germany's Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation, with the first round of the Strategic Dialogue set for early 2027.

item.title: Qatar Museums opened the "Doha Pavilion - Gerhard Richter" in the Museum of Islamic Art park in the presence of Sheikha Al Mayassa bint Ham…
item.description:
Qatar Museums opened the "Doha Pavilion - Gerhard Richter" in the Museum of Islamic Art park in the presence of Sheikha Al Mayassa bint Hamad Al Thani, Chairperson of Qatar Museums' Board of Trustees. The German artist designed the hexagonal building specifically for the site with architect Annabelle Selldorf; it houses three large new "Strips" paintings, the sculpture "Tower of Strips", two large mirrors and an outdoor stone sculpture titled "Brunnen" (The Well). The opening is part of the "Qatar Creates" season and coincides with the first Qatar Quadrennial 2026, running until 30 April 2027.

item.title: The 13th Gulf Studies Forum opened in Doha, organised by the Arab Center for Research and Policy Studies until 23 November across 17 sessio…
item.description:
The 13th Gulf Studies Forum opened in Doha, organised by the Arab Center for Research and Policy Studies until 23 November across 17 sessions. Eight sessions are devoted to Gulf security after the US-Israeli war on Iran, covering energy security, sea lanes and the war's repercussions for Gulf relations with Yemen and Iraq, and seven to language policies in the Arab Gulf states, including a presentation of the "State of Qatar Arabic Language Index" project.

item.title: Bahrain's Interior Ministry said on Saturday evening that an Iranian attack had struck a civilian industrial facility, causing a fire and m…
item.description:
Bahrain's Interior Ministry said on Saturday evening that an Iranian attack had struck a civilian industrial facility, causing a fire and material damage with no injuries, according to preliminary reports, as Civil Defence teams worked to bring the blaze under control. The ministry had earlier issued an urgent alert urging citizens and residents to move to the nearest safe location and avoid main roads. It did not name the site; residents told AFP they saw smoke over Sitra Island.

item.title: The UK Maritime Trade Operations agency said two outbound tankers were hit by unidentified projectiles near Oman's Khasab on Saturday: the …
item.description:
The UK Maritime Trade Operations agency said two outbound tankers were hit by unidentified projectiles near Oman's Khasab on Saturday: the first on its stern at about 05:00 GMT, 11 nautical miles north of the port, and the second in its engine room 50 minutes later, 17 nautical miles to the east. No casualties were reported and it was unclear whether the incidents involved the same vessel, while Iran's navy claimed a tanker had struck a naval mine in restricted waters.

item.title: The Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted and destroyed three ballistic missiles fired by the Houthis towards Riyadh early on Saturday, a…
item.description:
The Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted and destroyed three ballistic missiles fired by the Houthis towards Riyadh early on Saturday, and later a Houthi drone aimed at the south of the kingdom. It was the third day in a row of emergency alerts in the capital, two days after a Houthi strike damaged the Public Investment Fund tower, and followed coalition strikes on Houthi positions in Sanaa and the port of Hodeidah on Friday.

item.description:
President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi told the sixth Aswan Forum for Sustainable Peace and Development that Africa must be an active partner in shaping the rules of the international order rather than merely receiving them, and that peacebuilding and post-conflict reconstruction are an urgent priority and a shared international responsibility. The forum runs on 21 and 22 November under the title "Redefining Shared Global Common Ground: Africa's Active Role in an Age of Disruption".

item.title: Gold prices fell in Egypt on Saturday, with the 21-carat gram selling at about EGP 5,460, down EGP 115 from Friday, the 24-carat gram at EG…
item.description:
Gold prices fell in Egypt on Saturday, with the 21-carat gram selling at about EGP 5,460, down EGP 115 from Friday, the 24-carat gram at EGP 6,240 and the gold pound at EGP 43,680, down EGP 920. Globally, the ounce ended the week at USD 3,537.90, down about 8.9%, its biggest weekly loss in eight months, under pressure from a strong dollar and expectations of a US rate hike.
Sources: Bankygate https://www.bankygate.com/202871 · Al Ain News https://al-ain.com/article/gold-price-today-in-egypt-saturday-21-nov-2026

item.title: COP31 talks in Antalya ran into an extra day on Saturday after the second draft dropped every reference to fossil fuels, as Australia, whic…
item.description:
COP31 talks in Antalya ran into an extra day on Saturday after the second draft dropped every reference to fossil fuels, as Australia, which presides over the negotiations, prepared a third draft. The latest draft proposes that electricity meet 35% of final energy demand by 2035 without requiring it to be renewable, and the removal of a USD 120 billion adaptation finance target angered developing countries. COP31 President Murat Kurum called for an "Antalya Consensus".

item.title: EU climate commissioner Wopke Hoekstra said there was "no compromise yet" and that "it's better to have no deal than to have a bad deal", w…
item.description:
EU climate commissioner Wopke Hoekstra said there was "no compromise yet" and that "it's better to have no deal than to have a bad deal", warning that the current text risked turning the summit into a "fossil summit". A group led by France and Panama, including Belgium, Côte d'Ivoire, Finland, Greece, Guatemala, Spain, Sweden and Vanuatu, demanded an explicit commitment to transition away from fossil fuels, while Panama threatened to walk away.

item.title: European Council President Antonio Costa on Saturday proposed cutting the EU's 2028-2034 budget by EUR 40 billion to EUR 1.58 trillion comp…
item.description:
European Council President Antonio Costa on Saturday proposed cutting the EU's 2028-2034 budget by EUR 40 billion to EUR 1.58 trillion compared with the Irish presidency's proposal, about EUR 180.6 billion below the Commission's original plan, along with a 3% digital tax on net revenue from online advertising, digital intermediation and user data for large companies. EU leaders will discuss the plan at a special summit on 26-27 November.
Sources: Investing.com https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/eu-budget-chief-proposes-40-bln-cut-and-digital-tax-plan-5043471 · Global Banking & Finance Review (Reuters) https://www.globalbankingandfinance.com/eu-leaders-chair-proposes-new-cuts-eu-2028-2034-budget-draft/

item.title: The death toll from a fire at the Hartha thermal power station north of Basra rose to 4, with 35 injured, after a blast in a gas pipeline f…
item.description:
The death toll from a fire at the Hartha thermal power station north of Basra rose to 4, with 35 injured, after a blast in a gas pipeline feeding the plant spread flames to nearby homes and cars, damaging more than 17 houses. Civil Defence said the fire was under control; the station halted operations and an investigation into the cause is under way.
Sources: The Peninsula (QNA) https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/21/11/2026/death-toll-from-basra-power-station-fire-rises-to-four-with-35-injured · Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/21/at-least-two-people-killed-as-fire-engulfs-power-station-in-southern-iraq

item.title: At least 11 people died and more than 180 were hospitalised after drinking tainted alcohol in Manipur in north-eastern India, according to …
item.description:
At least 11 people died and more than 180 were hospitalised after drinking tainted alcohol in Manipur in north-eastern India, according to the state's Chief Minister Yumnam Khemchand Singh, who ordered an inquiry and pledged to punish those responsible.
Sources: Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/21/suspected-toxic-alcohol-kills-at-least-11-people-in-northeast-india · 24NewsHD (AFP) https://www.24newshd.tv/21-Nov-2026/11-dead-180-hospitalised-drinking-illicit-alcohol-india
